identity: Whitebridge sells the same river basket twice while poachers, wolves and wetland collectors each claim a toll.

quests.title: Sold Twice, Delivered Never
quests.text: Unlicensed Poachers buy stolen river baskets in the {name:oakwood} {dir_of:r20_anchor_016:oakwood} after nightfall. Defeat five of them there. Basket-Poacher Thorn signs both halves of every sale, and I would like his customers to start declining.
quests.lesson: A night outlaw roster in a forest kind.

quests.title: The Pack at the Back Door
quests.text: Briarpack Wolves hunt the {name:meadows} {zone_area:meadows} at night, right where our carts go round Thorn's buyers. Defeat five of them after dark. Wolves call the pack when hurt, so work the edge of it instead of its middle.
quests.lesson: Pack calls: pull from the edge.

quests.title: Thorn's Double Sale
quests.text: {name:basket_poacher_thorn} keeps his duplicate labels at his own spot {dir_from_giver:basket_poacher_thorn}, day and night. Defeat him. Then I can tell Ansel which baskets his kitchen actually paid for, and Thorn can explain the rest to nobody.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader on his own: a fixed, memorable fight.

quests.title: The Other End of the River Trade
quests.text: Thorn's labels name buyers among the Elves too. Find Ilwen Petalmeasure at Lorindor Berrycourt in Lorindor; she will want to know who has been spending her coin, and she has work for someone who asks good questions. One of three roads I can offer you.

quests.title: A Ledger for the Dwarves
quests.text: Some of Thorn's baskets went to Dur Brannoc, sold as Dwarven freight. Take his labels to Dorrin Gateledger in Dur Brannoc; the Dwarves take a forged ledger very personally. One of three roads I can offer you.

quests.title: Cold Storage
quests.text: The last of Thorn's labels points to Tarnwatch Fold in Frostbarrow Shelf. Find Edda Tarnmantle there and tell her whose baskets she has been buying. Pack something warm. One of three roads I can offer you.

quests.title: A Measure That Stays Put
quests.text: Bring me six planks of any wood and six Steel Bars at Bridgechalk Dig. You have worked bronze and iron; now alloy iron with coal for steel that holds my surveying brace through the weather. Gather and smelt whenever it suits you.

quests.title: A Survey for the Heights
quests.text: Carry my survey to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights. The Accord holds that ground only as long as its maps stay honest. Reach level 30 before you go; the heights are contested and do not care how good your boots are.

quests.title: The Basket Toll
quests.text: Toll Mirefolk charge for every river basket at the {name:ferry_camp} {dir_from_giver:ferry_camp}, day and night. Defeat five of them. They rush to help each other inside their camp, so keep your fights at its edge.
quests.lesson: A swarm camp: fight at the edge.

quests.title: Murk's Final Fare
quests.text: {name:ferryman_murk} runs the {name:ferry_camp} {dir_from_giver:ferryman_murk} and calls his tolls honest fares. Defeat him. The river will still have thieves, but none who can sign for them.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader at the camp centre.

quests.title: Bounty: Briar-Web Spiders
quests.text: Briar-Web Spiders string the {name:thornwood} {zone_area:thornwood} shut every night. Kill six there after dark and I will pay again each time. The next bounty opens twenty-five minutes after you hand this one in.
